intro.proseHTML:
Truth discipline

Every claim on this map carries its evidence class: [OBSERVED] verified by direct read this session, [DERIVED] from the 2026-09-01 PM handoff or planning artifacts, [REPORTED] via A/EXEC-ODIN's GO packet. Active candidates are never drawn as integrated code — the two worktree lanes at south are physically separate checkouts, verified via git worktree list.

The city

North: the doctrine district (rulebook, role cards, the pinned skill). Center: the referee — the MCP server and everything deterministic around it. West-south: trust machinery (activation gates, audits, tests). East-south: substrates — note herdr amber-roofed: advertised but not implemented. The release story runs the trace: dispatch → lanes → checkpoint → publish → fleet sync.

Reading the roofs

Paper is healthy, amber owes work, blue is being built, and a slate diamond marks an operator decision — the merge/tag/publish steps on the checkpoint block are yours alone, Brad. Press R to return home; click any building for its evidence; click a pipe to read what flows.
